verdict.rationale: Sketch's document 'starred versions' feature (sketch-docs-10/28/33/41) lets users track history, indicate important updates, and control which versions become Library updates, and this general version history would apply to changes made via AI/MCP automation features (sketch-docs-49, 14-39) since they operate on the same Sketch documents. However, there is no evidence of a dedicated review/rollback mechanism specific to AI-driven automations (e.g., diffing or reverting individual AI actions like text-style recreation or dark-mode conversion) — only generic document versioning is documented. Missing for 10: AI-action-specific audit trail, per-automation rollback, and any review workflow tied directly to MCP/AI operations rather than whole-document version history.
